about.title: About {industry} on System News
about.description: How we choose, score, and summarize {industry} news.
about.body1: System News collects approved publisher feeds for {industry}, scores each story for relevance, and groups coverage of the same event. We publish a short original summary in the story's own language and always link to the publisher.
about.body2: We do not store article bodies or rehost images. One channel covers one industry, and every channel is available in English and Spanish without machine translation.
about.how1: Every feed is declared by language, so English and Spanish coverage are scored and deduplicated separately.
about.how2: AI writes a short summary in the story's language. If the provider is unavailable, headlines and links still publish.
about.how3: Refreshes run twice a day by default and can be forced by an operator. A rolling window keeps the desk current.
about.contact: Questions or a correction? Contact the desk.

legal.privacyBody: System News stores only what it needs to run the desk: feed metadata, article headlines and links, aggregated usage counts, and messages or lead requests you choose to send. We do not sell personal data. We store a hashed network identifier, a hashed device identifier, campaign parameters, and a coarse country code when the network edge provides one, to prevent abuse and measure aggregate interest; we do not store raw IP addresses. Lead requests are shared only with the partner for the channel you selected. Contact the desk to request an export or deletion.
legal.termsBody: System News publishes headlines, excerpts, and original summaries with attribution and links to the publisher. Content remains the property of its publisher. Nothing on this site is legal, financial, medical, or professional advice. Use of the site is at your own risk; automated access must respect the published rate limits.

faq.title: The ones we get on the first call.
faq.a1: A pipeline reads the primary sources and drafts. A person signs the reference issues. Every item links to the record it came from.
faq.a2: Summaries are drafted by a model from the source text and published with the source cited. Reference issues are reviewed and signed. We name the model and the reviewer on request.
faq.q3: Can I read only one industry?
faq.a3: Yes. Each desk has its own site and feed, and publishes a brief where we have one. None of them require an account.
faq.a4: Yes, where the desk has Spanish coverage. Depth varies by desk, and the Spanish side of a new desk is thinner for the first weeks.
faq.a5: No. We publish news and route you to independent specialists. Nothing on this site is legal, financial, or medical advice.
faq.q6: Can you run a desk under our brand?
faq.a6: That is the news service. It starts with a scope call and a four-week pilot.
faq.q7: What does it cost to read?
faq.a7: Nothing. No account, no paywall. A feed may carry a small, labelled promotion, usually for one of our own desks or services.
faq.a8: Every desk publishes RSS 2.0 and a documented JSON API. For commercial use, talk to us.

bot.title: HeraldFox crawler
bot.intro: This page is for the operators of feeds we read: who we are, what we fetch, how often, and how to stop us.
bot.identityBody: Every request carries the user agent HeraldFoxBot/1.0 (+https://heraldfox.com/bot), and the address in it opens this page.
bot.readingBody: Public RSS and Atom feeds that we list as sources: the headline, the link, the publication date and the excerpt the publisher already publishes. We do not copy full articles, do not log in anywhere, and do not imitate a browser.
bot.pacingBody: We follow robots.txt and its Crawl-delay, leave a few seconds between two requests to the same host, make no more than twenty requests to one host in an hour, and wait as long as a server asks us to through Retry-After.
bot.blockBody: Add a rule for HeraldFoxBot to your robots.txt - Disallow: / is enough - or write to {email} and we will stop reading the feed.
bot.allowlistBody: If your robots.txt refuses us we stop, and we do not retry for a week. Write to {email} if that is a mistake. If you want us to keep reading, allow HeraldFoxBot or our host's address in robots.txt, or send us the user agent or token to use for your feed. We do not pretend to be a browser.
